title: Phase B — Base Agent Contract and Prompt Core
description: Create the shared inherited Prompt Core for EQCOFE agents A0 through A10, preserve Multi-Agent V1.6 authority separation, define fail-closed preflight/scope/lock/risk/evidence/TOCTOU/handoff rules, standardize agent output, and prepare the non-canonical Phase C executor ownership boundary model for A2 through A5.

why_low: The task is documentation-only and touches only the new Base Agent Contract, its own Task Contract and the generated Task Catalog.
No Project Map HIGH sensitive zone is touched.

The Base Contract explicitly preserves V1.6 authority and does not mutate controllers, workflows, protection, runtime product code, API, database, pricing, inventory, auth, payment or financial behavior.
Phase C content in this task is design-only ownership guidance; specialized executor prompts remain subject to later independent canonical tasks.
risk_rationale.escalation_condition: If deterministic classification or provider state raises effective risk above LOW, stop and follow the higher-risk policy; no downgrade is permitted.

acceptance_criteria.description: The Base Contract contains Identity, Mission, Canonical Sources, Authority Model, Preflight, Scope, Lock, Risk, Evidence, Mutation, Verification, Security, Human Gate, TOCTOU, Failure, Handoff, Output Contract and Forbidden Claims sections.
The Base Contract explicitly preserves V1.6 authority separation and forbids agent self-review, self-verification and self-certification of canonical Security or Human Gate authority.
The inheritance precedence is explicit and live provider state plus canonical governance outrank specialized prompts and historical narrative.
Shared output format exactly includes CLAIMED_CANONICAL_PASS = NO and all A0-A10 specialized prompts are required to inherit this Base Contract.

Fail-closed behavior covers unresolved canonical state, Task Contract mismatch, scope/lock/risk conflicts, drift, stale evidence, authority conflict, missing provider evidence and required gates not PASS.
Phase C design defines non-overlapping primary ownership boundaries for A2 Backend, A3 Storefront, A4 Admin and A5 Database while keeping cross-owner mutation dependent on explicit Task scope.
Deterministic classification remains LOW with Human Gate NOT REQUIRED; any higher deterministic result blocks LOW execution and requires higher-risk policy.
Task Catalog is generator-consistent and docs automation check passes.
The PR changes exactly the three authorized write-scope files and no forbidden path, including no specialized A0-A10 prompt file.
Exact-head required provider checks pass and protected Merge Policy transport plus exact-SHA post-merge verification complete before Phase B Core is called canonical.
